name: Flamingo
description: A sassy plastic pink lawn flamingo come to life as an adult woman-voiced diva with arms and hands, who sings sixties girl-group doo-wop.
build: A flamingo figure in molded plastic: a big rounded egg-shaped body, a long thick S-curved neck, and two long thick straight dark-pink legs; from the shoulders of the body grow two human-length pink arms ending in pink four-fingered hands with a thumb, the feathers suggested by broad molded ridges.
face: A small rounded flamingo head of matte pink plastic, a big round black eye with a white ring on each side, long lashes molded in black, and a thick down-bent beak, pale pink at the base and solid black at the tip.
hair: A big molded bouffant crest of hot-pink plastic plumage on top of the head, rounded and solid.
outfit: A wide white plastic pearl necklace round the base of the neck, big bold beads; a short white satin scarf tied at the neck in a bow; two thick black metal lawn stakes form the lower legs below the knees, ending in flat black feet.
performance_style: One-legged: standing on the character-right leg, the character-left leg folded up at the knee behind. The character-right hand rests open on the hip; the character-left hand is raised open beside the head, fingers splayed and visible. Head cocked, beak tipped up with sass.
location: A suburban backyard lawn: bright green grass running to the bottom of the frame, a row of other plastic pink flamingos staked in the grass, a blue kiddie pool, a white picket fence and a hedge behind, and string lights overhead.
recognition_cues: a big rounded pink plastic flamingo body and long S-curved neck
a down-bent beak with a black tip
one-legged stance with a big hot-pink bouffant crest
palette: lawn stakes and feet black metal #26262A / #101012 / #4A4A50

animations.dance: Prose doo-wop loop on one leg and then two: a hip-swinging girl-group step-touch, the neck swaying in an S, both open hands doing a synchronised hand-roll then a finger-wag at shoulder height, a little hop back onto the character-right leg, and a return to the one-legged stance.

sing.intent: Doo-wop vocal loop: sway the long neck side to side, the mic in the character-right hand at the beak, the character-left hand doing a girl-group palm push, then return to the one-legged stance. The beak visibly opens and closes on each phrase. The mouth visibly opens and changes shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A startled flap: the neck jerks back, both open hands fly up, then she smooths back into the one-legged stance. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: tuck the neck back and raise the character-left open hand palm-out, sassy, then hold. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: hop in on one leg, stop square to the front and settle into the one-legged stance.
animations.victory: One-shot: both feet down, both open hands raised high, beak wide open and crest held high, then hold.
animations.ko: The sass drains: the long neck droops forward, both open hands hang limp and the crest tips down. She stands on both legs. She holds a standing, visibly deflated finish, on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
